Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live"

Indian  Standard 

SPECIFICATION  FOR 
CHAPATI  MACHINE

1.  Scope  —  Specifies  dimensions,  performance  and  general  requirements  for  CHAPATI  machine  in 
four  sizes* 

2.  Shape  and  Dimensions  —  As  shown  in  Fig.  % 

2.1  The  shape  and  dimensions  shown  in  Fig.  1  represent  a  typical  design  only.  The  design  different 
from  that  given  In  this  standard  may  also  be  made  subject  to  agreement  between  the  purchaser  and 
the  supplier,  provided  it  satisfies  other  requirements  of  the  standard, 

2.2  The  deviation  allowed  on  untoleranced  dimensions  shall  be  in  accordance  with  Class  2  of 
IS  :  4897-1968  'Deviation  for  untoleranced  dimensions  and  weight  of  steel  castings  \ 

3.  Materials 

3.1  Body  (Upper  Disct  Lower  Disc  and  Lever)  —  Grey  iron  casting  conforming  to  any  grade  of 
IS  :  210-1978  '  Specification  for  grey  iron  castings  ( third  revision  ) !  or  die-casiing  aluminium  alloy 
conforming  to  IS  :  617-1975  4  Specification  for  aluminium  and  aluminium  alloy  ingots  and  castings  for 
general  engineering  purposes  (  second  revision  )  \ 

3.2  Working  Surface  Sheets  —  Stainless  steel  sheets  0*80  mm  thick  conforming  to  IS:  5522-1969 
1  Specification  for  stainless  steel  sheets,  coils  and  circles  for  utensils  and  hospitalware1  or  rigid 
PVC  sheets  1'5  mm  thick  conforming  to  Type  1  or  Type  3  of  IS  :  6307-1971  Specification  for 
rigid  PVC  sheets  \ 

3.3  Bolt  Nut  and  Hinge  Pin—  Bolt  and  nut  shallconform  li  15:2585-1988  'Specification  for  black 
square  bolts  and  nuts  (diameter  range  6  to  39  mm)  and  black  square  screws  (diameter  range 6 
to  24  mm  )  (  first  revision )  \  Hinge  pin  shall  be  made  from  carbon  steel  ( see  Designation  C40  of 
IS  :  1570-1961  Schedules  for  wrought  steels  for  general  engineering  purposes  ). 

4.  Construction  and  Workmanship 

4.1  The  cast  components  shall  be  free  from  porosity,  blowholes,  pits,  cracks  and  other  casting 
defects.    They  shall  be  well  dressed  and  fettled  and  shall  be  readily  machinable.  , 

4.2  Shape  of  the  lever  shall  be  such  that  while  pressing  with  it,  the  fingers  do  not  get  hurt  or  pinched. 

4.3  The  working  surface  plates  shall  be  prepared  by  suitably  machining  the  internal  surfaces  of 
upper  and  lower  discs  which  shall  ba  finished  smooth  and  then  electroplated  with  tin.  The  plating 
shall  conform  to  classification  No.  Sn  25  S  of  IS  :  1359-1977  *  Specification  for  electroplated  coatings 
of  tin  (  second  revision )  \  Alternatively,  separate  stainless  steel  or  PVC  sheets  as  specified  under  3.2 
may  be  pasted  on  the  upper  and  lower  discs  of  working  surface  plates  by  means  of  suitable  waterproof 
adhesive.  Prior  to  pasting,  the  disc  surfaces  shall  be  well  cleaned  and  machine  finished  to  give  a 
smooth  and  level  surface.  The  pasting  shall  be  such  that  the  sheets  shall  not  be  removed  with  ease 
and  they  shall  not  be  liable  to  come  out  during  norma!  use. 

4.4  Working  surfaces  shall  be  perfectly  smooth,  flat  and  free  from  scratches. 

4.5  Lever  pivot  and  the  disc  hinge  shall  not  be  sticky  or  hard  to  operate. 

5.  Finish 

5.1  The  body  and  the  lever  of  t\m  CHAPATI  machine  shall  be  painted  all  o\{er  ( except  the  working 
surfaces)  by  stove  enamel  paint,  as  prescribed  in  IS  :  151-1950  '  Specification  for  ready  mixed  paint, 
spraying,  finishing,  stoving,  enamel,  for  general  purposes,  coiour  as  required  \  The  painted  coating 
so  obtained  shall  be  durable  and  shall  not  be  liable  to  peeloff.  Alternatively,  the  CHAPATI  machine 
shall  be  tin-plated  in  accordance  with  classification  No.  Sn  20  S  of  IS  1 1359*1977.

5.2  The  CHAPATl  machine  made  from  aluminium  (  see  3.1 )  may  be  anodized.  The  anodic  coating 
shall  conform  to  Grade  AC  10  of  IS  :  1868-1968  '  Specification  fof  anodic  coatings  on  aluminium 
(  first  revision  )  \ 

6.  Tests 

6.1  Performance  Test  —  Take  a  dough  of  ATT  A  of  working  consistency.  Make  it  round  and  flatten  it  by 
pressing  slightly  with  hand.  Place  it  in  the  centre  in  between  the  working  surfaces  of  the  CHAPATl 
machine,  after  applying  a  little  oil  or  ghee  on  the  surfaces.  Now  apply  an  average  pressure  with  the 
help  of  lever  on  CHAPATl  machine.  CHAPATl  formed  shall  be  reasonably  round,  of  uniform  thick- 
ness and  shall  be  approximately  of  the  same  size  as  that  of  the  working  surfaces. 

7.  Marking  —  The  CHAPATl  machine  shall  be  marked  with  manufacturer's  name,  initials  or  recogni- 
zed trade-mark  and  size  number. 

7.1  ISl  Certification  Marking  —  Details  available  with  the  Indian  Standards  Institution. 

8.  Packing  —  According  to  best  trade  practices  or  as  agreed  to  between  the  purchaser  and  the 

supplier.
